senses.sense_definition: Courtesy and considerate behavior towards others; social harmony.

examples.text: The neighbors maintained a sense of <w>comity</w> despite their differing political views.
A spirit of <w>comity</w> is essential for a peaceful and productive workplace environment.

senses.sense_definition: Friendly understanding and mutual recognition between two entities, especially nations.

examples.text: The treaty was signed in a spirit of international <w>comity</w> between the two neighboring countries.
Diplomats worked hard to restore <w>comity</w> after the long period of political tension.
